Welcome back. How was Singapore?
Very good, but very different. I moved the seminar to the evening, because most of my students work during the day.
Was that a good decision?
Yes. The room was small, so we met in the library. Although the library was cold, nobody missed a class.
And the reading list? Did you keep the same texts?
No. The texts were long, so I cut the list from twelve to eight. However, every student wrote one paragraph a week.
One paragraph a week? Why only one?
Because one good paragraph teaches more than ten bad pages. And you? Did you choose Miami or London in the end?
I chose the Friday group, because the class starts later.

It was expensive, but I think it was the right decision.

Good morning, Eduardo. Renata Lima, from the academic office. The Thursday seminar is full, so we are opening a second group on Friday. The Friday group is smaller: ten students. However, it has the same professor and the same reading list. The room is different. It is room 310, on the third floor. Although Friday is a long day for you, I recommend it, because the class starts at seven in the evening. Please choose a group before Monday. After Monday, I choose for you.

Eduardo, Paulo Rezende. I want to explain my decision about the corn. We did not sell in March, because the price was low: one hundred and ten reais a bag. So we kept the corn in our storage. Storage costs money, about two reais a bag every month. However, the price in May was one hundred and thirty, so we earned more. But the buyer in Cairo wants the cargo before June. Although the contract is ready, I need you to read clause nine today.
